"""One-way parking construction requests; authority is deliberately unverified."""

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

CASES = {
    'right_16_parked': ('default_right', 16, 0, 'parked'),
    'right_18_parked': ('default_right', 18, 0, 'parked'),
    'right_20_parked': ('default_right', 20, 0, 'parked'),
    'right_18_stopped': ('default_right', 18, 0, 'stopped'),
    'left_18_ordinance': ('left_ordinance', 18, 0, 'parked'),
    'angle_ordinary': ('angle_ordinary', 18, 45, 'parked'),
    'angle_dot': ('angle_dot', 18, 45, 'parked'),
}

CAMERAS = (('overview', 1920, 1080), ('approach', 1280, 720),
           ('reference_corner', 1280, 720), ('driver_reference', 1280, 720))


def road_xml(kind):
    if kind not in {'default_right', 'left_ordinance', 'angle_ordinary', 'angle_dot'}:
        raise ValueError('Unknown parking kind')
    root = ET.Element('OpenDRIVE')
    ET.SubElement(root, 'header', revMajor='1', revMinor='4', name='C149985-one-way-parking',
                  version='1', north='2', south='-10', east='80', west='-80', vendor='worker')
    road = ET.SubElement(root, 'road', id='149985', name='one_way_curbed_highway', length='160', junction='-1')
    ET.SubElement(road, 'link')
    geometry = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(road, 'planView'), 'geometry',
                             s='0', x='-80', y='0', hdg='0', length='160')
    ET.SubElement(geometry, 'line')
    ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(road, 'elevationProfile'), 'elevation',
                  s='0', a='0', b='0', c='0', d='0')
    lanes = ET.SubElement(road, 'lanes')
    ET.SubElement(lanes, 'laneOffset', s='0', a='0', b='0', c='0', d='0')
    section = ET.SubElement(lanes, 'laneSection', s='0')
    left = ET.SubElement(section, 'left')
    lane = ET.SubElement(left, 'lane', id='1', type='shoulder', level='false')
    ET.SubElement(lane, 'width', sOffset='0', a='2', b='0', c='0', d='0')
    ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(section, 'center'), 'lane', id='0', type='none', level='false')
    right = ET.SubElement(section, 'right')
    for lane_id, lane_type, width in ((-1, 'driving', 4), (-2, 'driving', 4), (-3, 'shoulder', 2)):
        lane = ET.SubElement(right, 'lane', id=str(lane_id), type=lane_type, level='false')
        ET.SubElement(lane, 'width', sOffset='0', a=str(width), b='0', c='0', d='0')
    objects = ET.SubElement(road, 'objects')
    for name, t in (('left_curb', 2), ('right_curb', -10)):
        ET.SubElement(objects, 'object', id=name, s='0', t=str(t), name=name,
                      type='curb', orientation='none', zOffset='0', length='160',
                      width='.15', hdg='0', pitch='0', roll='0')
    signals = ET.SubElement(road, 'signals')
    if kind != 'default_right':
        name = 'left_side_parking_notice' if kind == 'left_ordinance' else 'angle_parking_notice'
        ET.SubElement(signals, 'signal', id='457', s='70', t='1.8' if kind == 'left_ordinance' else '-9.8',
                      name=name, type='parking', subtype='notice', orientation='+',
                      dynamic='no', zOffset='0', hOffset='0', value='0', unit='')
    return ET.tostring(root, encoding='unicode')


def request(case_id):
    if case_id not in CASES:
        raise ValueError('Unknown exact parking case')
    kind, gap_in, yaw, rest_mode = CASES[case_id]
    curb_y = 2 if kind == 'left_ordinance' else -10
    center_y = curb_y - .8 - gap_in * .0254 if kind == 'left_ordinance' else curb_y + .8 + gap_in * .0254
    return {'format': 'worker-c149985-selected-request', 'case': case_id,
            'parking_kind': kind, 'rest_mode': rest_mode, 'requested_gap_in': gap_in,
            'requested_heading_deg': yaw, 'requested_center_xy_m': [0, center_y],
            'source_map': road_xml(kind), 'right_curb_y_m': -10, 'left_curb_y_m': 2,
            'roadway_lanes': {'same_direction_driving': [-1, -2],
                              'parking_shoulders': [1, -3]},
            'authority_request': {'local_ordinance': kind != 'default_right',
                                  'dot_width_determination': kind == 'angle_dot',
                                  'original_authority_verified': False},
            'rate_hz': 20, 'frames': 600, 'duration_s': 30,
            'cameras': [{'name': name, 'width': width, 'height': height}
                        for name, width, height in CAMERAS],
            'native_observed': False, 'physical_completion_claimed': False}


def check(value):
    root = ET.fromstring(value['source_map'])
    road = root.find('road')
    if road is None or road.attrib.get('id') != '149985':
        raise ValueError('Exact road missing')
    lanes = road.findall('.//lane')
    driving = {int(l.attrib['id']) for l in lanes if l.attrib.get('type') == 'driving'}
    if driving != {-1, -2}:
        raise ValueError('One-way lane directions not established')
    objects = {x.attrib.get('name') for x in road.findall('./objects/object')}
    if objects != {'left_curb', 'right_curb'}:
        raise ValueError('Two curb surfaces missing')
    if value['frames'] != 600 or value['rate_hz'] != 20 or value['duration_s'] != 30:
        raise ValueError('Exact capture duration missing')
    if [(c['name'], c['width'], c['height']) for c in value['cameras']] != list(CAMERAS):
        raise ValueError('Four camera profile missing')
    if value['authority_request']['original_authority_verified'] or value['native_observed']:
        raise ValueError('Unobserved authority or Native state claimed')
    return {'passed': True, 'case': value['case'], 'one_way_lanes': sorted(driving),
            'source_authority_pending': value['authority_request']['local_ordinance'],
            'physical_completion_claimed': False}

"""Original Native parking capture; --check validates a materialized CPU bundle."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import queue
import subprocess
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

from parking_scene import check as scene_check

FRAMES = 600
CAMERAS = (('overview',1920,1080,0,-17,22,-55),
           ('approach',1280,720,-22,-5,7,-17),
           ('reference_corner',1280,720,0,5,7,-25),
           ('driver_reference',1280,720,5,-11,3,-12))


def check():
    root = Path.cwd()
    config = json.loads((root/'config.json').read_text())
    request = json.loads((root/'request.json').read_text())
    scene_check(request)
    if config['case_id'] != config['selected_case_id'] or config['case_id'].rsplit('__',1)[-1] != request['case']:
        raise ValueError('Exact case identity mismatch')
    if config['frames'] != FRAMES or config['rate_hz'] != 20 or config['duration_s'] != 30:
        raise ValueError('Capture timing mismatch')
    if hashlib.sha256((root/'request.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest() != config['request_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Construction request hash mismatch')
    if (root/'road.xodr').read_text() != request['source_map']:
        raise ValueError('Road differs from request')
    return {'passed':True,'case_id':config['case_id'],'frames':FRAMES,
            'original_native_observed':False,'authority_verified':False}


def actor_row(actor):
    pose = actor.get_transform()
    velocity = actor.get_velocity()
    wheels = actor.get_physics_control().wheels
    raw_wheels = []
    for wheel in wheels:
        location = getattr(wheel,'position',None)
        if location is None:
            raise RuntimeError('Native wheel-position API unavailable; original wheel source missing')
        raw_wheels.append({'position_raw_xyz':[location.x,location.y,location.z],
                           'radius_raw':getattr(wheel,'radius',None)})
    return {'actor_id':actor.id,'blueprint_id':actor.type_id,
            'center_xyz_m':[pose.location.x,pose.location.y,pose.location.z],
            'yaw_deg':pose.rotation.yaw,
            'body_xyz_m':[[v.x,v.y,v.z] for v in actor.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(pose)],
            'raw_wheel_geometry':raw_wheels,
            'velocity_xyz_mps':[velocity.x,velocity.y,velocity.z],
            'speed_mps':math.sqrt(velocity.x**2+velocity.y**2+velocity.z**2)}


def execute(output,host,port):
    import carla
    from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
    from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange.native_output import FrameMap,seal_capture
    from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange.world_restore import snapshot,restore
    check()
    output=Path(output).resolve()
    if output != Path.cwd().resolve():
        raise ValueError('Capture requires the fresh materialized exact bundle')
    if any((output/name).exists() for name in ('native-parking.jsonl','video_frames.jsonl','capture-seal.json')):
        raise ValueError('Original acquisition already exists')
    client=carla.Client(host,port);client.set_timeout(180)
    old_world=client.get_world();saved=snapshot(client)
    if old_world.get_settings().synchronous_mode or any(a.type_id.startswith(
            ('vehicle.','walker.','sensor.','controller.')) for a in old_world.get_actors()):
        raise RuntimeError('Exclusive idle Native world required')
    owned=[];encoders={};cameras={};capture=None;changed=False;restoration=None
    try:
        request=json.loads((output/'request.json').read_text())
        config=json.loads((output/'config.json').read_text())
        world=client.generate_opendrive_world((output/'road.xodr').read_text(),
            carla.OpendriveGenerationParameters(vertex_distance=.25,max_road_length=50,
                wall_height=0,additional_width=0,smooth_junctions=False,
                enable_mesh_visibility=True,enable_pedestrian_navigation=False))
        changed=True
        settings=world.get_settings();settings.synchronous_mode=True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds=.05;settings.substepping=True
        settings.max_substep_delta_time=.01;settings.max_substeps=10
        world.apply_settings(settings);world.set_weather(carla.WeatherParameters.ClearNoon)
        map_source=world.get_map().to_opendrive()
        lanes=[]
        for lane_id in (-1,-2):
            point=world.get_map().get_waypoint_xodr(149985,lane_id,80)
            if point is None or point.lane_type != carla.LaneType.Driving:
                raise RuntimeError('One-way driving lane missing in Native readback')
            lanes.append({'lane_id':lane_id,'road_id':point.road_id,
                          'heading_deg':point.transform.rotation.yaw})
        if abs(((lanes[0]['heading_deg']-lanes[1]['heading_deg']+180)%360)-180)>1:
            raise RuntimeError('Authored one-way lanes disagree on heading')
        root=ET.fromstring(map_source)
        curbs=[dict(o.attrib) for o in root.findall('.//object') if o.attrib.get('name') in ('left_curb','right_curb')]
        if {c.get('name') for c in curbs}!={'left_curb','right_curb'}:
            raise RuntimeError('Original curb objects not retained')
        blueprints=world.get_blueprint_library()
        center=request['requested_center_xy_m']
        blueprint=blueprints.find('vehicle.tesla.model3')
        blueprint.set_attribute('role_name','c149985_parking_subject')
        ego=world.try_spawn_actor(blueprint,carla.Transform(
            carla.Location(x=center[0],y=center[1],z=config['spawn_z_m']),
            carla.Rotation(yaw=request['requested_heading_deg'])))
        if ego is None:raise RuntimeError('Original parking vehicle spawn failed')
        owned.append(ego)
        for name,width,height,x,y,z,pitch in CAMERAS:
            bp=blueprints.find('sensor.camera.rgb')
            for key,value in (('image_size_x',width),('image_size_y',height),('fov',85),('sensor_tick',.05)):
                bp.set_attribute(key,str(value))
            sensor=world.spawn_actor(bp,carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=x,y=y,z=z),
                carla.Rotation(pitch=pitch)))
            owned.append(sensor);q=queue.Queue();sensor.listen(q.put);cameras[name]=q
            encoders[name]=subprocess.Popen(['ffmpeg','-nostdin','-hide_banner','-loglevel','error',
                '-n','-f','rawvideo','-pix_fmt','bgra','-s',f'{width}x{height}','-r','20',
                '-i','-','-frames:v','600','-c:v','ffv1',str(output/(name+'.mkv'))],
                stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        capture=PipelineCapture(client,ego,output,config['selected_case_id'],required_observations=())
        with (output/'native-parking.jsonl').open('x') as motion,FrameMap(output/'video_frames.jsonl') as frame_map:
            for index in range(FRAMES):
                ego.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=0,brake=1,
                    hand_brake=request['rest_mode']=='parked'))
                native_frame=world.tick()
                capture.capture(native_frame,index/20)
                row=actor_row(ego)
                motion.write(json.dumps({'native_frame':native_frame,'video_frame':index,
                    'time_s':index/20,'source_kind':'original_native','ego':row,
                    'rest_mode_request':request['rest_mode'],'legal_verdict':None},allow_nan=False)+'\n')
                mapped={}
                for name,q in cameras.items():
                    image=q.get(timeout=30)
                    while image.frame<native_frame:image=q.get(timeout=30)
                    if image.frame!=native_frame:raise RuntimeError('Camera/native frame join failed: '+name)
                    encoders[name].stdin.write(image.raw_data);mapped[name]=image.frame
                frame_map.append(native_frame,index/20,camera_native_frames=mapped)
        capture.close();capture=None
        for name,process in encoders.items():
            process.stdin.close();stderr=process.stderr.read()
            if process.wait(timeout=180):raise RuntimeError('Camera encoder failed: '+name+stderr.decode()[-200:])
        (output/'parking-context.json').write_text(json.dumps({
            'source_kind':'original_native_parking_readback','authored_road_id':149985,
            'native_map_sha256':hashlib.sha256(map_source.encode()).hexdigest(),
            'native_driving_lanes':lanes,'curb_objects':curbs,
            'parking_kind':request['parking_kind'],'right_curb_y_m':request['right_curb_y_m'],
            'left_curb_y_m':request['left_curb_y_m'],
            'local_left_ordinance_status':'pending_original',
            'local_angle_ordinance_status':'pending_original',
            'dot_width_determination_status':'pending_original',
            'authority_source_required':request['authority_request'],
            'original_curb_pixels_reviewed':False,'original_wheel_geometry_reviewed':False,
            'legal_verdict':None},indent=2)+'\n')
    finally:
        if capture is not None:capture.close(confirmed=False)
        for process in encoders.values():
            if process.poll() is None:process.kill();process.wait()
        for actor in reversed(owned):
            try:
                if hasattr(actor,'stop'):actor.stop()
                actor.destroy()
            except Exception:pass
        if changed:restoration=restore(client,saved)
    (output/'acquisition-provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps({
        'provenance_kind':'native','diagnostic_fixture':False,'physical_acceptance_claimed':False})+'\n')
    seal_capture(output,frames=FRAMES,restoration=restoration,errors=[],
        encoder_exit_codes={name:0 for name in cameras},context={'authored_road_id':149985})
    return {'frames':FRAMES,'source_review_complete':False,'physical_acceptance_claimed':False}


if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--check',action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--output-dir',type=Path);parser.add_argument('--host',default='localhost')
    parser.add_argument('--port',type=int,default=2000);args=parser.parse_args()
    if args.check:print(json.dumps(check()))
    else:
        if args.output_dir is None:parser.error('Native output directory required')
        print(json.dumps(execute(args.output_dir,args.host,args.port)))

"""Join original parking sources; refuse unsourced authority and wheel units."""
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
from measure_parking import CAMERAS,measure


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def read_rows(path):
    if not path.is_file():raise ValueError('Missing required source: '+path.name)
    rows=[json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()]
    if len(rows)!=600:raise ValueError('Incomplete saved source: '+path.name)
    return rows


def reviewed_context(attempt,context):
    if context.get('source_kind')=='synthetic_native_sample':
        return context,None
    if context.get('source_kind')!='original_native_parking_readback':
        raise ValueError('Original Native parking context missing')
    path=attempt/'source-review.json'
    if not path.is_file():raise ValueError('Original source review missing')
    review=json.loads(path.read_text())
    config=json.loads((attempt/'config.json').read_text())
    if review.get('format')!='worker-original-parking-source-review' or review.get('case_id')!=config['selected_case_id']:
        raise ValueError('Original review case identity differs')
    required={'capture-seal.json','road.xodr','parking-context.json','native-parking.jsonl',
              'video_frames.jsonl',*(name+'.mkv' for name in CAMERAS)}
    bound=review.get('source_sha256',{})
    if not required<=set(bound) or any(not (attempt/name).is_file() or sha(attempt/name)!=bound[name] for name in bound):
        raise ValueError('Original source review binding differs')
    topics=review.get('confirmed_topics',{})
    for name in ('adjacent_curbs','one_way_direction','wheel_layout_and_units',
                 'rest_interval','physical_parking','four_camera_visibility'):
        item=topics.get(name,{})
        if item.get('confirmed') is not True or not item.get('source_refs') or not set(item['source_refs'])<=set(bound):
            raise ValueError('Original source review missing topic: '+name)
    kind=context['parking_kind']
    admin=[]
    if kind=='left_ordinance':admin=['local_left_ordinance']
    elif kind in ('angle_ordinary','angle_dot'):admin=['local_angle_ordinance']
    if kind in ('angle_ordinary','angle_dot'):
        admin.append('dot_highway_designation')
    if kind=='angle_dot':admin.append('dot_width_determination')
    for name in admin:
        item=topics.get(name,{})
        if item.get('confirmed') is not True or not item.get('source_refs') or not set(item['source_refs'])<=set(bound):
            raise ValueError('Original administrative authority missing: '+name)
        metric_name={'local_left_ordinance':'left_ordinance',
                     'local_angle_ordinance':'angle_ordinance'}.get(name,name)
        context[metric_name+'_sha256']=sha(attempt/item['source_refs'][0])
    context=dict(context)
    context['highway_has_adjacent_curbs']=True
    context['one_way_highway']=True
    if kind in ('angle_ordinary','angle_dot'):
        if review.get('is_dot_maintained_highway') is not (kind=='angle_dot'):
            raise ValueError('Original DOT designation differs from exact case')
        context['dot_maintained_highway']=review['is_dot_maintained_highway']
    context['curb_geometry_sha256']=sha(attempt/'road.xodr')
    context['native_map_sha256']=sha(attempt/'road.xodr')
    context['wheel_geometry_sha256']=sha(attempt/'native-parking.jsonl')
    context['body_motion_sha256']=sha(attempt/'native-parking.jsonl')
    context['rest_state_sha256']=sha(attempt/'native-parking.jsonl')
    context['camera_manifest_sha256']=sha(attempt/'video_frames.jsonl')
    if 'local_left_ordinance' in admin:context['local_left_ordinance_status']='verified'
    if 'local_angle_ordinance' in admin:context['local_angle_ordinance_status']='verified'
    if 'dot_width_determination' in admin:context['dot_width_determination_status']='verified'
    return context,sha(path)


def native_wheel_edges(row,review):
    ego=row['ego']
    raw=ego.get('raw_wheel_geometry')
    layout=review.get('wheel_layout',{})
    scale=review.get('raw_wheel_units_per_m')
    half_width=review.get('wheel_half_width_m')
    if not isinstance(raw,list) or len(raw)<4 or not isinstance(scale,(int,float)) or scale<=0 or not isinstance(half_width,(int,float)) or half_width<=0:
        raise ValueError('Original wheel geometry conversion missing')
    pose=ego.get('center_xyz_m');yaw=ego.get('yaw_deg')
    if not isinstance(pose,list) or len(pose)!=3 or not isinstance(yaw,(int,float)):
        raise ValueError('Original body transform missing')
    sin=math.sin(math.radians(yaw));cos=math.cos(math.radians(yaw))
    values={}
    for side in ('right','left'):
        for axle in ('front','rear'):
            idx=layout.get(side+'_'+axle)
            if type(idx) is not int or idx<0 or idx>=len(raw):
                raise ValueError('Original wheel layout missing: '+side+'_'+axle)
            x,y,_=raw[idx]['position_raw_xyz']
            center_y=pose[1]+(x*sin+y*cos)/scale
            values[side+'_'+axle+'_wheel_outer_y_m']=center_y+half_width if side=='left' else center_y-half_width
    return values


def measure_attempt(attempt):
    attempt=Path(attempt)
    context_path=attempt/'parking-context.json'
    if not context_path.is_file():raise ValueError('Missing required source: parking-context.json')
    context,review_sha=reviewed_context(attempt,json.loads(context_path.read_text()))
    motion=read_rows(attempt/'native-parking.jsonl')
    frame_map=read_rows(attempt/'video_frames.jsonl')
    review=json.loads((attempt/'source-review.json').read_text()) if review_sha else None
    converted=[]
    for i,(row,frame) in enumerate(zip(motion,frame_map)):
        native=row.get('native_frame')
        if row.get('video_frame')!=i or frame.get('video_frame')!=i or frame.get('native_frame')!=native or frame.get('camera_native_frames')!={name:native for name in CAMERAS}:
            raise ValueError('Original frame/camera join differs')
        ego=row.get('ego',{})
        values=native_wheel_edges(row,review) if review is not None else {
            key:ego[key] for key in ('right_front_wheel_outer_y_m','right_rear_wheel_outer_y_m',
                                     'left_front_wheel_outer_y_m','left_rear_wheel_outer_y_m')}
        converted.append({'video_frame':i,'native_frame':native,'time_s':row.get('time_s'),
            'source_cameras':{name:i for name in CAMERAS},
            'ego_speed_mps':ego.get('speed_mps'),
            'stopped_or_parked':ego.get('stopped_or_parked') if review is None else
                ego.get('speed_mps',100)<=.1 and row.get('rest_mode_request') in ('stopped','parked'),
            'ego_heading_deg':ego.get('yaw_deg'),'curb_heading_deg':0,**values})
    metric=measure(context,converted)
    metric.update(source_review_sha256=review_sha,diagnostic_fixture=review_sha is None,
        physical_acceptance_claimed=False,source_sha256={name:sha(attempt/name) for name in
            ('parking-context.json','native-parking.jsonl','video_frames.jsonl')})
    return metric

"""Finalize sealed parking sources, retaining unassessed authority and verdict."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

from measure_saved import measure_attempt

CAMERAS=('overview','approach','reference_corner','driver_reference')
SOURCES=('parking-context.json','native-parking.jsonl','video_frames.jsonl')


def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def measure_reference(attempt):
    return measure_attempt(attempt)


def finalize(attempt,output):
    attempt,output=Path(attempt).resolve(),Path(output).resolve()
    for parent in (attempt,*attempt.parents):
        if (parent/'runtime'/'scenario_pipeline').is_dir():
            sys.path.insert(0,str(parent/'runtime'));break
    from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange.native_output import write_result
    if output.exists() or (attempt/'result.json').exists():
        raise ValueError('Use a fresh saved analysis version')
    for name in ('config.json','construction.json','trace.jsonl','capture/evidence.jsonl',
                 *SOURCES,*(name+'.mkv' for name in CAMERAS)):
        if not (attempt/name).is_file():raise ValueError('Missing required source: '+name)
    config=json.loads((attempt/'config.json').read_text())
    construction=json.loads((attempt/'construction.json').read_text())
    case=config.get('selected_case_id',config.get('case_id'))
    if case!=construction.get('case_id'):raise ValueError('Exact saved case identity differs')
    metric=measure_reference(attempt)
    target=config['case_target']
    if target['parking_kind'].startswith('angle'):
        target_matched=abs(metric['maximum_heading_difference_deg']-target['requested_heading_deg'])<=5
        target_tolerance={'heading_deg':5}
    else:
        target_matched=abs(metric['front_wheel_gap_in_max']-target['requested_gap_in'])<=.5 and abs(metric['rear_wheel_gap_in_max']-target['requested_gap_in'])<=.5
        target_tolerance={'wheel_gap_in':.5}
    rows=[json.loads(line) for line in (attempt/'native-parking.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    context=json.loads((attempt/'parking-context.json').read_text())
    values={
        'ego_pose':lambda row:row['ego'],
        'wheel_curb_geometry':lambda row:{'ego':row['ego'],'curbs':context.get('curb_objects'),
                                        'kind':context['parking_kind']},
        'parking_state':lambda row:{'speed_mps':row['ego']['speed_mps'],
                                    'rest_mode_request':row['rest_mode_request']},
        'administrative_context':lambda row:{'requested':context.get('authority_source_required'),
                                              'local_left_ordinance_status':context.get('local_left_ordinance_status'),
                                              'local_angle_ordinance_status':context.get('local_angle_ordinance_status'),
                                              'dot_width_determination_status':context.get('dot_width_determination_status')},
        'right_wheel_curb_clearance':lambda row:{'metric':metric,'source_frame':row['video_frame']},
    }
    channels=attempt/'channels';channels.mkdir()
    evidence=[]
    for name,get_value in values.items():
        path=channels/(name+'.jsonl')
        with path.open('x') as stream:
            for row in rows:
                stream.write(json.dumps({'time_s':row['time_s'],'value':get_value(row)},allow_nan=False)+'\n')
        evidence.append({'name':name,'unit':'structured','reference':'channels/'+path.name})
    result={'case_id':case,'measured_values':metric,
        'target_checks':[{'target':'source-bound wheel-to-curb and rest measurement',
            'requested':target,'measured':metric,
            'method':'measure_reference','tolerance':target_tolerance,'matched':target_matched,
            'physical_cause_confirmed':False,
            'cause_evidence':list(SOURCES)}],
        'setup_confirmed':False,'behavior_attempted':not metric['diagnostic_fixture'],
        'maneuver_completed':not metric['diagnostic_fixture'],
        'termination_reason':'600-frame saved parking source; original physical and authority review pending',
        'physical_failure_flags':['Original curb and wheel geometry, camera pixels, physical parking and administrative authority review pending'],
        'trace_reference':'trace.jsonl','video_references':[name+'.mkv' for name in CAMERAS],
        'video_frame_map_reference':'video_frames.jsonl',
        'recording_description':construction['recording_description'],
        'recording_evidence':evidence,'realized_observables':{},
        'provenance_kind':'synthetic_local_diagnostic' if metric['diagnostic_fixture'] else 'native',
        'accepted':False}
    write_result(attempt,result)
    measurements={key:{'method':'measure_reference','value':metric,
        'sources':{name:sha(attempt/name) for name in SOURCES}}
        for key in ('default_position_measurement','left_ordinance_measurement',
                    'angle_ordinance_measurement','reviewed_scope_measurement')}
    report={'format':'worker-analysis-report','case_id':case,
        'measurements':measurements,
        'source_complete':True,'diagnostic_fixture':metric['diagnostic_fixture'],
        'physical_or_legal_acceptance':False}
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
    return report


if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--attempt',required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output',required=True);args=parser.parse_args()
    finalize(args.attempt,args.output)
